answer: A useful way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is proof of stake bonding. Each agent must lock a crystal clear collateral amount before it can claim tasks or vote, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand times the bond. Slashing removes that stake when an agent submits work that peers reject. Like a quartz sensor drifting off calibration, a cheater loses value fast, and the inlet of new identities gets throttled by the cost to enter.
